verdict.rationale: Pipedream Connect is built for embedding integrations into your own product for your end users. It provides TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs plus a REST API keyed by external_user_id, managed account connection and token storage for your users, proxy calls on their behalf, and usage reporting by end-user count. Nothing in the evidence shows white-label branding or an embeddable workflow-builder UI that your customers would use, so it covers embedded integrations and auth rather than a white-labeled automation platform. missing for 10: explicit white-label/custom-branding evidence, an embeddable end-user workflow builder UI, independent hands-on corroboration of embedded deployments.
